Zainab Akhtar

Senior Product Manager | Product Owner | Business Analyst | Digital Transformation | Agile Delivery | SAFe® POPM

+91- 9178577286 • zainab.akhtar845@gmail.com • Bangalore, India https://www.linkedin.com/in/zainab-akhtar-aa44b4b6/

SUMMARY

Senior Product Manager, Product Owner, and Business Analyst with 11+ years of experience delivering enterprise digital transformation initiatives across Global Banking, Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, and Telecommunications. Experienced in Business Analysis, Product Ownership, Target Operating Model (TOM) support, Business Process Transformation, AS-IS/TO-BE Process Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, Stakeholder Management, and Agile delivery. Proven ability to translate strategic business objectives into scalable technology solutions through requirements management, business capability assessment, product roadmaps, and cross-functional collaboration.

EXPERIENCE

Wells Fargo	Bangalore, India

Senior Product Manager	Aug 2022 – Present

Project: ORE and Escalations Application

Defined product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and enterprise priorities.

Contributed to defining future-state operating models (Target Operating Model) supporting digital transformation initiatives.

Conducted AS-IS / TO-BE process assessments to identify operational gaps and recommend optimized business workflows.

Participated in customer journey mapping workshops with UX, Product, and Business stakeholders to improve end-user experience.

Collaborated with Enterprise Architecture and Product teams to align business capabilities with strategic product roadmaps.

Supported business capability assessments to identify automation and process improvement opportunities.

Prepared impact assessments and transformation roadmaps to support enterprise change initiatives and business process modernization.

Owned the end-to-end product lifecycle, balancing strategic initiatives with stakeholder feedback and evolving business goals.

Led Agile delivery by facilitating Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, and Retrospectives.

Partnered with engineering, UX, QA, architecture, and business teams to translate requirements into Epics, Features, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria.

Prioritized the product backlog based on business value, customer impact, technical feasibility, and organizational objectives.

Acted as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and development teams, ensuring alignment on scope, releases, and timelines.

Conducted stakeholder feedback sessions to validate functionality, prioritize enhancements, and improve product value and usability.

Managed governance, release planning, delivery tracking, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure predictable product delivery.

Société Générale	Bangalore, India

Product Owner	Jul 2021 – Aug 2022

Projects: GDPR Compliance Platform | DQHub (Data Quality Tool)

Defined GDPR governance processes, roles, and responsibilities supporting enterprise-wide regulatory compliance initiatives.

Contributed to defining the Target Operating Model (TOM) for GDPR governance and enterprise data management.

Conducted business process assessments and gap analysis to align regulatory requirements with future-state operating processes.

Worked with business and technology stakeholders to define business capabilities supporting enterprise data governance.

Facilitated workshops with Compliance, Risk, and Technology teams to validate future-state operating models.

Contributed to implementing the organization's GDPR operating model, including consent management and compliance measures.

Collaborated with business and technology teams to translate regulatory requirements into actionable product deliverables.

Supported development of a centralized platform for reporting and managing Data Quality and Infrastructure issues.

Validated delivered functionality against Acceptance Criteria using JIRA to ensure quality and business compliance.

Prioritized backlog items, collaborated with development teams, and actively participated in Agile ceremonies.

Partnered with stakeholders to align regulatory initiatives, platform capabilities, and enterprise product priorities.

Supported continuous improvement of enterprise data governance, compliance, and quality management processes.

AcesoCloud	Bangalore, India

Business Analyst	Jun 2018 – Jul 2021

Projects: Internal Audit - Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) | Appeals and Grievances (ANG)

Gathered, analyzed, and documented business requirements through stakeholder workshops, interviews, and requirement sessions.

Created BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, process flows, and functional specifications supporting successful solution delivery.

Conducted Gap Analysis, SQL-based data analysis, and Business Intelligence reporting to identify trends and improvement opportunities.

Designed dashboards and executive reports to monitor KPIs and support data-driven business decisions.

Acted as the liaison between business and technology teams, translating requirements into development-ready specifications.

Facilitated stakeholder workshops, requirement walkthroughs, and solution discussions to drive project alignment.

Developed UAT scenarios, test cases, and coordinated business validation to ensure solution quality.

Developed end-to-end process maps, customer journeys, and workflow models supporting Governance, Risk & Compliance solutions.

Created business capability documentation and process models to support enterprise transformation initiatives.

Performed impact assessments and business process optimization across multiple functional areas.

Supported end-to-end SDLC activities while collaborating with development and QA teams throughout Agile delivery.

Infosys	Bangalore, India

Business Analyst	May 2015 – Jun 2018

Project: Telstra

Gathered, documented, and validated business requirements and enhancement requests from key stakeholders.

Developed comprehensive BRDs covering business processes, system requirements, risks, and functional specifications.

Collaborated with development teams to support solution design, issue resolution, and successful implementation.

Coordinated requirement changes and resolved functional gaps throughout the Software Development Lifecycle.

Maintained requirement traceability to ensure alignment between business objectives and delivered solutions.

Facilitated communication between business and technical teams to support project execution and stakeholder alignment.

Supported testing, implementation, and production readiness to ensure successful solution delivery.

Contributed to cross-functional collaboration and continuous improvement throughout project execution.

EDUCATION

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science • GPA: 8.7	Jul 2011 – Jun 2015

Institute of Technical Education and Research (SOA University)	Bhubaneswar, India

SKILLS

Product Management & Leadership

Business Analysis & Delivery

Data, Governance & Compliance

Tools & Platforms

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified SAFe® Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM)

Scaled Agile Framework

Infosys Mysore Training

Infosys
